title: Markets dashboard
summary: A backend-less markets dashboard on public exchange feeds: aggregates and alerts in the visitor's tab, native and on Isoloop, with React and with Preact, in Lite, Normal and Heavy sizes.

result.line: In the React builds at Normal and Heavy, Isoloop keeps the main thread 17–21% busy against 42–59% for native, and uses 1.3–1.5× the CPU across all threads, 1.6–2.7× the memory and 20–30 ms more per keystroke; neither build drops frames on the CI runner.
